# The administration surface of the worklist scheme (C1.6, C3.5).
# THIS FILE IS THE EXPECTATION, beside verb-surface.tsv and apart from it. It
# is transcribed from the order that builds the surface (REA-0011 S4, TAR-0002
# B13, ADR-0040: administration is resources, never verbs) and from the
# service contract, and it is NOT derived from the built code.
# Every route under /api/{scope}/admin/... is a row here, and a JAX-RS route
# that is in neither this file nor verb-surface.tsv is a defect (C3.5). None
# of these calls is a verb: no tool of tools/list names one, the declaration
# of GET /api/declaration carries none (C4.8, C5.7), and the verb
#   call      the call of the administration surface, in snake case
#   path      the route, exactly as it must be registered
#   access    read: the read right of the scope; administer: the write right
#             of the scope, until the administration permission exists
#             (REA-0011 S15), refused without it as ROLE_INSUFFICIENT
# Statuses, with their phase and predicates. No change of a status: the
# registry carries none, and a used status is withdrawn, never retyped.
# The optional predicates and properties a scope uses (DEC-0037 C5). A usage
# Attribute definitions with their options, the type of an item among them.
# Relation types, duplicate_of with its target status (REA-0011 D18). No
# Workstreams (D5): read and query stay verbs of the work surface.
# The settings, the default column set among them.
